decision: Retain Ridge/Logistic champion; compact challenger and calibrators not promoted.
calibration: UNCALIBRATED_LOGISTIC; no claim that raw outputs are empirically calibrated.
freeze: No indicator/model/threshold/calibration changes during the 20 sessions. Any predictive configuration change starts a new experiment; unavailable days count against coverage and never produce fabricated trades.

evaluation.version_matching: exact config_hash; morning publication before open; actual outcome observed after official close
evaluation.uncertainty: Bootstrap whole trading dates; never treat 22 correlated tickers as 22 independent sessions.
evaluation.promotion: No promotion before 20 new sessions. Require matched-date error, direction, calibration, net trading and stability evidence; no threshold tuning on this period.

limitations: This is champion operational forward validation, not a promotion test for compact features.
Legacy selected_columns remains null to preserve the champion transformation/coverage procedure; exact transformed-column freeze has not been promoted.
No historical or already inspected holdout is sealed again.
